question: How does the self-dependent reality directly produce the range from Sadāśiva to inert matter?
premises: The range extends from Sadāśiva to the inert level.
This whole range is made directly.
inference: The autonomous self directly generates the entire spectrum of reality from highest to lowest.
plain_english: It directly makes this whole range, from Sadāśiva down to the inert level, as something self-dependent.
